# 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 378v–379r

---

**15:1** And-he-made [vayyaas] for-himself houses [battim] in-the-city of-David, and-he-prepared [vayyakhen] a-place [maqom] for-the-ark of-God [ha-Elohim], and-pitched [vayyit] for-it a-tent [ohel].

**15:2** Then said David: None [lo] shall-carry [laseit] the-ark of-God except [ki im] the-Levi'im, for in-them chose [bachar] YHWH to-carry the-ark of-YHWH and-to-minister [le-shareto] to-him until forever [ad olam].

**15:3** And-assembled [vayyaqhel] David all Yisra'el to-Yerushalayim, to-bring-up the-ark of-YHWH to its-place [mekomo] which he-had-prepared [hekhin] for-it. **15:4** And-gathered David the-sons of-Aharon and-the-Levi'im.

**15:5** Of-the-sons of-Qehat: Uri'el the-chief [ha-sar], and-his-brothers — one-hundred and-twenty. **15:6** Of-the-sons of-Merari: Asayah the-chief, and-his-brothers — two-hundred and-twenty. **15:7** Of-the-sons of-Gershom: Yo'el the-chief, and-his-brothers — one-hundred and-thirty. **15:8** Of-the-sons of-Elitsafan: Shemayah the-chief, and-his-brothers — two-hundred. **15:9** Of-the-sons of-Chevron: Eli'el the-chief, and-his-brothers — eighty. **15:10** Of-the-sons of-Uzzi'el: Amminadav the-chief, and-his-brothers — one-hundred and-twelve.

**15:11** And-called David for-Tsadoq and-Evyatar the-priests, and-for-the-Levi'im: for-Uri'el, Asayah, and-Yo'el, Shemayah, and-Eli'el, and-Amminadav. **15:12** And-said to-them: You [are] the-heads [rashei] of-the-fathers [ha-avot] of-the-Levi'im. Sanctify-yourselves [hitqadashu], you and-your-brothers, and-bring-up the-ark of-YHWH, God of-Yisra'el, to [the place] I-have-prepared [hakhinoti] for-it.

**15:13** For because [ki le] the-first-time [ba-rishonah] — you [did] not [carry it] — YHWH our-God broke-out [parats] against-us, for not did-we-seek-him [derashnuhu] according-to-the-ordinance [ka-mishpat].

**15:14** And-sanctified-themselves [vayyitqadshu] the-priests and-the-Levi'im to-bring-up the-ark of-YHWH, God of-Yisra'el. **15:15** And-carried [vayyis'u] the-sons of-the-Levi'im the-ark of-God [ha-Elohim], as commanded [tsivvah] Moshe according-to-the-word of-YHWH, upon their-shoulders [bi-khtepham] with-the-poles [ba-mottot] upon-them.

**15:16** And-said David to-the-chiefs of-the-Levi'im to-station [le-ha'amid] their-brothers the-singers [ha-meshorerim] with-instruments [bi-khlei] of-song [shir]: lyres [nevalim] and-harps [kinnorot] and-cymbals [metsiltayim], sounding-aloud [mashmi'im] to-raise [le-harim] a-voice [qol] of-joy [simchah].

**15:17** And-stationed [vayyaamedu] the-Levi'im: Heyman son of-Yo'el, and-from his-brothers — Asaf son of-Berekhyahu, and-from the-sons of-Merari, their-brothers — Etan son of-Qushayahu.

**15:18** And-with-them their-brothers of-the-second [rank] [ha-mishneh]: Zekharyahu, Ben, and-Ya'azi'el, and-Shemiramot, and-Yechi'el, and-Unni, Eli'av, and-Benayahu, and-Ma'aseyahu, and-Mattityahu, and-Eliflehu, and-Miqneyahu, and-Oved-Edom, and-Ye'i'el, the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim].

**15:19** And-the-singers [ha-meshorerim]: Heyman, Asaf, and-Etan — with-cymbals of-bronze [metsiltei nechoshet] to-sound-aloud [le-hashmi'a]. **15:20** And-Zekharyahu, and-Azi'el, and-Shemiramot, and-Yechi'el, and-Unni, and-Eli'av, and-Ma'aseyahu, and-Benayahu, with-lyres [bi-nevalim] upon Alamot [al alamot]. **15:21** And-Mattityahu, and-Eliflehu, and-Miqneyahu, and-Oved-Edom, and-Ye'i'el, and-Azazyahu, with-harps [be-khinnorot] upon the-Sheminit [al ha-sheminit] to-lead [le-natseach].

**15:22** And-Kenanyahu, chief [sar] of-the-Levi'im, in-the-carrying [ba-massa] — he-instructed [yassor] in-the-carrying, for he [was] skilled [mevin] [in it]. **15:23** And-Berekhyah and-Elqanah [were] gatekeepers [sho'arim] for-the-ark. **15:24** And-Shevanyahu, and-Yoshafat, and-Netan'el, and-Amasai, and-Zekharyahu, and-Benayahu, and-Eli'ezer, the-priests, [were] blowing [machatsrerim] with-the-trumpets [ba-chatsotsrot] before the-ark of-God. And-Oved-Edom and-Yechiyyah [were] gatekeepers for-the-ark.

**15:25** And-it-was David and-the-elders of-Yisra'el and-the-commanders of-the-thousands, the-ones-going to-bring-up the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH from-the-house of-Oved-Edom with-joy [be-simchah]. **15:26** And-it-was when-God helped [ba-ezor ha-Elohim] the-Levi'im, the-bearers [nos'ei] of-the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH, that-they-sacrificed [vayyizbchu] seven bulls [parim] and-seven rams [eilim].

**15:27** And-David [was] wrapped [mekhubal] in-a-robe [me'il] of-fine-linen [butz], and-all the-Levi'im, the-bearers of-the-ark, and-the-singers, and-Kenanyahu the-chief [ha-sar] of-the-carrying [ha-massa] of-the-singers; and-upon David [was] an-ephod [efod] of-linen [bad]. **15:28** And-all Yisra'el [were] bringing-up the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH with-shouting [bi-tru'ah] and-with-sound of-the-horn [be-qol shofar] and-with-trumpets [ba-chatsotsrot] and-with-cymbals [ba-metsiltayim], sounding-aloud with-lyres [nevalim] and-harps [kinnorot].

**15:29** And-it-was [when] the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH came to the-city of-David, and-Mikhal daughter of-Sha'ul looked-down [nishqefah] through the-window [ba-challon], and-saw King David dancing [meraqed] and-celebrating [u-mesacheq], and-she-despised [vattibbez] him in-her-heart [be-libbah].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — ki im ha-Levi'im:** "None except the Levites" — this is the Chronicler's key correction. The first attempt (ch. 13) used a cart; now David explicitly cites Levitical prerogative. The entire chapter exists to demonstrate that Torah obedience governs worship.

**v.13 — ka-mishpat:** "According to the ordinance" — the critical phrase. David now understands that seeking God includes following prescribed procedure. *Mishpat* here is not "justice" but "regulation/ordinance."

**v.20-21 — al alamot / al ha-sheminit:** Musical terms of uncertain meaning. *Alamot* may mean "maidens" (soprano register?) and *sheminit* means "the eighth" (bass register? octave?). These appear in psalm titles (Pss 46, 6) and remain debated.

**v.22 — ba-massa:** This could mean "in carrying" (from *nasa*) or "in song/oracle" (from *massa*). The Chronicler may intend a double meaning: Chenaniah supervised both the physical transport and the musical performance.

**v.29 — vattibbez:** "She despised" — the chapter ends on this jarring note. Michal, daughter of Saul, rejects David's worship. The Chronicler includes this from 2 Samuel 6:16 but omits the subsequent confrontation scene. Saul's house stands in permanent opposition to David's liturgical revolution.

*— EMET*
